premise.claim: When the command succeeds but its output does not have the master address on the second line (empty output, a single line, or `Master Address:` without a value), the function panics with `index out of range` instead of returning the error it was written to return.
premise.reportedComponent: pkg/ddc/alluxio/operations/base.go AlluxioFileUtils.MasterPodName (called from pkg/ddc/alluxio/backup_data.go generateDataBackupValueFile for HA runtimes, Spec.Replicas > 1)
premise.evidence: base 253f6bb + PR test cases -> panic 'index out of range [1] with length 1' at base.go:487; two-field second line -> 'index out of range [2] with length 2' at data[2]; see results/premise-base-panic.txt and results/premise-base-panic-data2.txt

findings.claim: Under malformed-but-successful `alluxio fsadmin report` stdout, MasterPodName must return an error, not panic. Base: panics (index out of range [1]/[2]). Head 2796b35: returns error for all four malformed cases.
